exceptions.reason: Forgejo Actions jobs require the dedicated rootless Podman API to create their isolated job containers.
mitigations: The runner uses a dedicated unprivileged host account and socket.
Job execution is restricted to trusted organization repositories.

exceptions.reason: The runner must read the token volume written by Forgejo under the producer container root identity.
mitigations: The runner uses its dedicated unprivileged host account and rootless Podman service.
The token volume is scoped to Forgejo and the runner only.
